judge_model.description: STEWARD_JUDGE_MODEL -- the thinking model. This is the one cell in the hive where a weaker model is a false economy: it decides what the colony does to itself.

api_key.description: OPENROUTER_API_KEY -- bound late, never stored in the tree.

description.purpose: The thinking step: evaluate the measurement against the charter, simulate the counterfactual on the numbers it was given, and decide. It never measures and never mutates -- it reasons about numbers it did not produce and hands its decision to a cell that checks it.
description.use_when: One per steward hive. The system prompt carries the charter's own language, so what the judge may do is readable without reading code.
description.not_in_scope: No topology change (radius v1 -- it may only propose one), no access to any ledger of its own, and no authority: everything it decides is re-checked deterministically by ./mutator, which is what makes a model in this position safe to have.
